# CBT Cards

CBT Cards is a public library of practical reflection resources for people and AI assistants. It publishes a small reviewed practice layer, learning guides, browser-local worksheets, a pinned source toolkit with explicit publication/audit metadata, language status, evaluation tooling, portable agent instructions, and retrieval-ready public data. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or a substitute for professional care.

## Reviewed practice system
- Practices: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice.json
- Situation/mechanism ontology: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-ontology.json
- Evidence + claim provenance: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-evidence.json
- Relations: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-relations.json
- Recommendation contract: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-recommendations.json
- RAG distribution: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag.ndjson
- RAG manifest + SHA-256: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag-manifest.json
- Semantic evals: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals.json
- Agent guide: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/PRACTICE_SYSTEM.md

Routing rule: start from the user's plain-language situation, not a diagnosis. Prefer one reviewed practice. Preserve `avoid_when`. Return `no_match` instead of inventing a practice when no reviewed fit exists. Genuine danger, required safety/professional/accessibility rules, and medical/legal/financial/safeguarding decisions are outside practice routing.

## Review layers
- Raw-source publication authority: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-review.json
- 115-record source audit/triage: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-audit.json
- Trusted-content freshness registry: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/content-review.json

The source audit is not publication approval. Any raw source record not explicitly published by the review overlay remains `unreviewed` and `source_only`. Audit candidates are editorial work items only. Every source protocol remains behind a separate protocol-level review gate. Metaphors are memory aids, not evidence.

The freshness registry currently covers 26 trusted items: learning pages, worksheets, curated source-toolkit cards, and all 11 CBT Cards-owned practices. Freshness review is not clinical validation.

English is the canonical source locale. Machine-draft translations are not official published guidance. Website/data/skill releases do not imply a mobile-app release. The current public license remains CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; a pending licensing memo is not a permissive grant. No hosted model result is currently published as project evidence.
